title: fix(plugin-detail): a laid-out record page whose first details block draws no body keeps its approval band
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_

Fixes #35483

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR also carries the folded card #35484 (authored page with two details nodes), closed into this one by the fold ruling on the card.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：记录被审批锁定时，「替换详情区」的记录页如果第一个详情区对当前用户隐藏（无权限）或自带标题，原来整页一个锁定标识都不显示，现在由下一个详情区显示一次；其他记录页不变。
- 为什么做：记录页「审批锁定标识每页只显示一次」的收尾，同时核实了自定义页面和页签回退两种情形已经只显示一次。
- 出错会怎样：只影响锁定标识显示在哪个详情区、显示几次，锁定规则本身不变；可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Measured first on `origin/main` a5a5312f, as the card asks. Three readings, each a rendered test on an approval-locked record through the real `record:details` / `page:tabs` renderers:

| Row | Page | Bands drawn |
|:---|:---|:---|
| (a) | synthesized page falling back to its `page:tabs` strip, two details parts, inside the host's `ApprovalBandOnceScope` | 1 (2 marks); 2 without the scope |
| (b) | authored page, two `record:details` nodes | 1 (already pinned at host level by the PR that closed the approvals-tab card) |
| (c1) | laid-out synthesized page split around a body table, first part with every section empty | 1 |
| (c2) | laid-out slotted page, `details` slot, first `record:details` withheld by `requiredPermissions` | **0** |
| (c3) | laid-out slotted page, `details` slot, first `record:details` with `showHeader: true` | **0** |
| (c4) | laid-out slotted page, two plain `record:details` | 1 |

Rows (a) and (b) were already fixed on `main` by the approvals-tab rework: the host wraps every page drawn as written in `ApprovalBandOnceScope`. The one reachable route to (a) is a slotted page that places a `page:tabs` node in a strip slot (`highlights`, `header`, `actions`, `alerts`): two strips, which `buildDefaultPageColumns` cannot partition. A page the synthesizer writes on its own always lays out.

What still failed is the case both cards name ("without dropping the band from a page whose first details node ... draws no body"): on the LAID-OUT page, `RecordPageColumns` gave the band to the first `record:details` node and set `ApprovalBandContext` false on every later one, so a first node that draws no band took it off the page. The fix gives the laid-out details column the same rule as a page drawn as written:

- `RecordPageColumns` wraps its details column in `ApprovalBandOnceScope`: the first details body that reaches the band's place draws it.
- `ApprovalBandContext` is removed: the per-part suppression was its only provider, and `DetailView` no longer reads it. It was module-internal (not in the barrel, not a prop, not a schema key), so no public face moves.
- `resolveApprovalLock` and the lock rule are untouched; a `lockRecord: false` approval still reads `In approval · editable`, once.

All edits are under `ui/packages/plugin-detail/**`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `RelatedList.tsx` are not touched.

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx` `drawDetailsNodes`: the scope replaces the per-part context; the band still sits above a body table on the split page.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`: the band now gates on the scope alone.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/defaultRecordPage.ts`: the context and its doc, merged into the scope's doc.

## Tests

- `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe (the shared harness file) pins a first part withheld by `requiredPermissions` and a first part with `showHeader: true` (band once, on the second part), a `lockRecord: false` approval behind a withheld first part (editable once, never locked), and CONTROLs for two drawing parts (band on the first), a single part, and a single withheld part (no band, notice shown). The harness's `record:details` stub now hands its node to the body it mounts.
- `DetailView.approvalBandOnce-35484.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe draws the synthesized page's `page:tabs` fallback through the real renderers: the page cannot be laid out and its overview holds two details parts; one band under the scope; CONTROL two bands without it; CONTROL one part draws its one band. The file header's pointer to the host pin now names the file that holds it.

Reverse verification (one-off, fix committed first): the three `src` files restored to a5a5312f, the two test files kept: 3 failed, 39 passed (the two first-part cases and the `lockRecord: false` case: no band found). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap: `overlap-check` reports PR #36234 (seat 1, the field-list card) sharing the four plugin-detail files, with a textual conflict in `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` (both append to it). Whichever lands second takes a mechanical merge of that test file.
- (a) is reachable only through a slotted page with a `page:tabs` node in a strip slot; whether that shape should be authorable at all is not this card's question (noted, not filed).

## Verification
